payload.content: When the question asks 'how many different/distinct/unique X', use `COUNT(DISTINCT x)` rather than `COUNT(x)` or `COUNT(*)`. Plain COUNT counts rows including duplicates and will overcount when the join or table contains repeated values of x.

rationale: Single-token substitution (COUNT → COUNT DISTINCT) keyed on 'distinct/different/unique' question wording; canonical SQL idiom for cardinality questions over joined tables.
